manual.title: BIOBUZZ Presented by RTX Competition Manual

teamUpdates.affects: none for autos (changes from last season)
Fig 9-10: bottom of HIVE above TILES is 30.6 in (was 25.5): the space under the HIVE stays drivable
G426 adds 'whichever comes first' and 'NECTAR does not have to be entered immediately when a HIVE TIP occurs': human feed in AUTO stays none by default
10.3.4 / G304.G: the 4 pre-loaded POLLEN may be held in or on the ROBOT or placed on the TILES on its own ALLIANCE side contacting the ROBOT

frame.name: pedro3_field
frame.origin: corner of the red ALLIANCE wall and the audience wall (red GARDEN corner)
frame.heading: 0 deg = +x, counter-clockwise positive
frame.redIs: the 180-degree rotation about (72, 72): (x, y, h) -> (144 - x, 144 - y, h + 180); never a mirror
sources: manual 9.1: approximately 144 in by 144 in inside the walls, 36 TILES of about 24 in
frame.visualizerNote: the stock Pedro-Pathing visualizer maps its field image to 141.5 in (config/defaults.ts FIELD_SIZE); the BIOBUZZ image is 6 x 6 tiles = 144 in, so AutoTool draws it at 144

allianceSide.source: G304.A / G402: FIELD columns A-C red, D-F blue; during AUTO navigating into the opposing side may be seen as STRATEGIC

loadingZone.source: manual 9.3, Fig 9-2/9-3 (read off the drawing, +-0.5 in on the tape edge; DSIM biobuzz config BB_LZ)

garden.source: manual 9.3 / 10.5.3, Fig 9-2/9-3 (strip depth off the drawing; DSIM BB_GARDEN)

cells.targetRule: own CELL on the robot's side of y = 72 (TeamCode config/Field.targetCell)
cells.source: HIVE pivots 25.5 in apart about the field centre (Fig 9-10), CELL centre 13.37 in from its pivot in plan (owner CAD 2026-09-12, DSIM BB_HIVE_CELL_DY); used only until the team enters H-1 (Tuned.redFarCellX ...)

flowerSource: manual 9.7, Fig 9-12; ring centre 2.54 in off the wall on the tile seam one tile off centre, foot 6 x 4.9 in (owner CAD 2026-09-12, DSIM BB_FLOWERS / BB_FLOWER_FOOT)

obstacles.name: HIVE frame base (red side)
obstacles.source: manual 9.6 Fig 9-8 frame 38.95 in deep; bar inner edge on the 24 in tile seam (owner CAD, DSIM BB_FRAME_BAR_IN/OUT, BB_FRAME_Y)

stagedSource: manual 10.3.1 / Fig 10-2: 4 POLLEN in each FLOWER, 4 in each GARDEN in a line from the corner nearest the ALLIANCE AREA touching the wall, 4 pre-loaded per ROBOT; 3 NECTAR in each up-CELL and 5 in each ALLIANCE AREA (not on the field). Garden positions: one POLLEN radius off both walls, one diameter apart (DSIM spawn.ts gardenLine)

clauses.A: fully on its own ALLIANCE side, inside the perimeter, no overhang
clauses.D: not contacting or in the scoring volume of a FLOWER
clauses.G: in contact with exactly 4 POLLEN pre-loads

autoSide.text: No AUTO opponent interference; navigating into the opposing side during AUTO is risky and may be STRATEGIC

flower.text: POLLEN may only be removed from the bottom of a FLOWER; NECTAR never

nectarFlower.text: NECTAR into FLOWERS only in the last 60 s: never in AUTO

humanFeed.text: NECTAR may be entered once per own HIVE TIP or with 60 s or less left; in a 30 s AUTO only after a TIP. AutoTool never counts on it

LEAVE.text: no longer contacting the perimeter wall at the end of AUTO

PARK.text: at least partially in the LOADING ZONE

CELL_REMAINING.text: POLLEN and/or NECTAR left in an upward-facing CELL at the end of the MATCH (no AUTO points)

tipPollenByNectar.text: index = NECTAR in the up-CELL, value = POLLEN that tips it; staged up-CELL holds 3 NECTAR, so 3 POLLEN tip it
tipPollenByNectar.source: Event Field Setup Guide V1.0 section 12 (DSIM BB_TIP_POLLEN)
